metadata.title: Meta Platforms Launches Debut Euro Bond Offering to Raise Over $9 Billion - WSJ

content.text:
Meta META 2.36%increase; up pointing triangle Platforms launched its debut euro bond offering Wednesday with the aim ofseeking to raise more than $9 billion, according to LSEG data.
The U.S. tech company is aiming to raise 8.25 billion euros ($9.23 billion) through the sale of four-year, six-year, eight-year, 12-year, 18-year and 38-year euro bonds.
